text: わたしの　しょうぶの　あまさを　いさぎよく　みとめるわ！

structure.jp: わたしの　しょうぶの　あまさを
いさぎよく　みとめるわ！

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for さ turns it into a thing: 'how soft it is'. あまさ = 'softness'.

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.span: いさぎよく　みとめる
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い to く lets a describing word say how an action is done. いさぎよく　みとめる = 'admit it graciously'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to add feeling. みとめるわ = 'I'll admit it'.
